changes: The 13 clips as one animation-only file.
Re-imported in Blender, it gives 13 takes of the right lengths and 59 bones. FBX drops the event markers, so art/goose/clips/manifest.json is the one record of the hit, release and roar times.
The scripts that build the rig, the clips, the metrics, the renders and the export.

Rebuild by running python3.11 art/goose/build_rig.py, then python3.11 art/goose/goose_clips.py with each of build, render and export in turn. The commands and their measured times are in art/goose/README.md.
Six things that look weaker than the rest, or that nobody has checked.

The turning tail sweep looks modest. The walk's body roll is small. In death, the crowns prop the heads slightly off the floor. Nothing checks whether a neck or wing passes through the body. The stills are low-sample (16 samples). No person has watched the MP4s.
